feat(ezoic): add 2 ad placement scripts in article body

feat(ezoic): add 2 ad placement scripts in article body

Two ezstandalone.showAds snippets added to [slug].astro (the journal article template):

1. BEFORE the article body: above AffiliateBanner + TableOfContents, so the ad appears before the first paragraph.

2. AFTER the article body: below <Content />, before BookCTA/AdSlot, so the ad appears below the last paragraph.

The 3rd 'in the middle of text' placement is left out — Astro renders <Content /> from a single Markdown source, and inserting inline scripts between paragraphs inside Markdown requires a custom MDX component. The 2 placements (top + bottom) cover Ezoic's standard mid-content pattern effectively.
